address: 7 Fore Street, Porthleven, TR13 9HQ, United Kingdom
bio: In summer, bag a table on the terrace of this small harbourside bistro; in winter, cosy up and watch the waves crash on the harbour wall. Coffee and cakes are served late morning, before giving way to more substantial fare. The menu flies the flag for Cornish produce, with local fish like hake and plaice nicely cooked by the kitchen team. They also run the deli and ice cream shop next door....
